chunks: When he comes to know something of Our messages he makes fun of them: For them is shameful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who mock the signs of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual decay of those who reduce profound divine revelations to mere objects of mockery, often citing the example of the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings being ridiculed by contemporaries. This derision signifies a deeper rejection of truth (Tahqir), warranting a humiliating punishment that reflects the degradation of their own status before God.
